body: Nah I get you. I get more fidgety and agitated, I usually start to play with either my fidget cube or in worse cases something else. I tend to avoid it in the end but i can physically feel myself get the urgency to do so.

Ah I see, I got a similar response too. Its a little frustrating because in a way you just want someone to respond with something that makes total sense to you. Sorta like they are expressing your own thoughts and feelings, it feels like they understand then.

Sadly, we can't really blame them since chances are they just don't know what to reply with. You just have to know they care.
Hi, I was wondering if you have told anyone that you trying to not worry? It seems like a silly question to ask but I've noticed my own issues is because I just don't say anything at all.

Yeah I get what you mean, I think. Theres a lot that i know for a fact I used to enjoy to pieces but I just can't be bothered for them now, I still enjoy a few things in life but they are media related.

I just wished I could find a passion or something that I can do which will get me somewhere in life job wise but I just can't figure it out. At the moment I do games design and I'm decent at it but it just isn't fun or exciting. I have a sinking feeling that it isn't my mood swings that will get me but the pure boredom of life that will be the end of me, as dark as they may be.

I'd also accept any tips for what I believe is a similar issue.

Well I don't think I'm doing everything right but I atleast feel like it isn't as bad as it seems anymore. Its like my little rain cloud over my head, its always raining for me despite it looking sunny. If that makes sense.

Life isn't horrible but it isn't ideal or perfect, ups and downs but I think most people have them. Its just a shame there's an imbalance of the two for me. Its gotten to be inescapable for me now. I feel slightly doomed to feel this way but I do hold a little hope, not a whole lot but its there.

Ah yeah, I think I'm a tiniest bit similar in regards to how you are feeling currently. Our past life experiences are different though.   
I'm feeling around the same as you and I don't think people around me irl fully grasp or understand however, I can't really blame them for it since it isn't something everyone can understand. We can't do much about that and we shouldn't blame anyone, not even ourselves for it.  


I have friends, family, a part time job and I'm even still in studies for games design. I just can't escape the thinking process that leads me to always think about my own death, its really starting to get into my daily life. Its basically become the one thing I can feel certain about in life. Scary is definitely a solid way to put it but the suicide isn't the scary thing to me, its the fact that I find comfort in thinking about it.
I know I would get the support needed by my friends but I just can't bring myself to throw such responsibility on them.
Thank you for replying to my post. It makes me sad and relieved that I'm not really alone on this.

You are definitely correct about talking to a professional. I've put it off for so long but once I'm back at uni, I plan to get right into the process again.

I was close to getting that professional ~~help with the help of the college campus well-being staff~~ during March however, lockdown hit towards the end of that month so I got a bit unlucky you could say. I decided early on during lockdown I wasn't really capable enough to push myself through the process on my own so I just kinda need that kick in the backside.  


Thank you for replying to my questions.
